commitResults.messageBody:
Help command previously opened a popup window with a link to the
help sheet. This requires users to leave the app to view help.

Let's,
* update the help command to display the list of available
commands and their usage directly in the result display instead.
* remove the help popup window and its associated F1 accelerator
as they are no longer needed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Contact class: Add tours field to Contact and subclasses
commitResults.messageBody:
Contact and its subclasses do not support associating tours with
contacts.

This is needed to allow filtering contacts by tour.

Let's,
* Remove Set<Contact> from Tour class
* Add Set<Tour> field to abstract Contact class
* Add tours logic to all Contact subclasses
* Update AddCommand parser to support tours input
* Use empty Set<Tour> as placeholder in test cases

commitResults.messageTitle: ContactCard: Display type-specific details for each Contact type
commitResults.messageBody:
ContactCard does not show type-specific details for Contact subclasses,
displaying only base fields for all contact types.

This makes it hard for users to distinguish between contact types at
a glance.

Let's,
* Add getTypeSpecificDetails() abstract method to Contact class
* Implement getTypeSpecificDetails() in all Contact subclasses
* Update ContactCard to display type-specific details
* Update ContactListCard.fxml to include detailsBox for type details
